orchestrator.note: runner: claude = Claude Code runs agent/DAILY.md with the tools in agent/kt.mjs; node = the old fixed program agent/run.mjs (OpenRouter text models); onDemandPerDay: runs asked for from parent mode (Run now), at most this many a day; effort: low|medium|high|xhigh|max (claude --effort)

profilesNote: Which profiles the helper runs, one after another: "kidtube/<folder>" (a folder in the data repo), "kidtube/*" (every folder with a profile.json), or {"path": "kidtube/x", "defaults": {...}} with its own defaults. Empty: the old layout, one child at the root of the repo. See agent/lib/profile.mjs.

speak.style: Say this in a cheerful, squeaky, excited cartoon-creature voice for a small child
speak.note: provider: device (tablet voice) | gemini (free tier) | openrouter (paid). Recordings are made for today's lines and played by the tablet.

listen.note: How the tablet hears his answers is a tablet rule (parent page → Talking friend → Hearing his answers), saved in parent-config presenter.voice.listen.

openrouter.note: free-first = free models, then the paid list; paid = only the paid list; specific = only the specific list

notesAgent.note: agent/poll.sh: new notes from the parent → Claude Code runs agent/NOTES.md in its own checkout (workDir); it changes the app or the helper and releases; at most perDay runs a day
